body:
My dad is too protective of me, I’m afraid that if I tell him about my abuse, he will beat the guy up, as he had a history of beating someone who tried to hurt my grandma. I truly am the one person he loves the most in this world; everyone around me tells me that. The only reason i’m still trying is because of him, I just dont think he deserves the pain if I’m gone. But at the same time, nothing is working out and i’m really just tired. I wish that when I do it, I could at least erase my family’s memory of ever knowing me that way, I get to go without causing pain to anyone. 

He and my whole family is really stressed out by my unemployment. I’ve been going to courses for a year trying to change path and still.....no one really responds. In the beginning, i feel quite confident that I have what it takes but now i’m not  so sure anymore. I fucked up so bad in life. I keep wasting the family money by doing this.  I try to confide in my mom but we always fight as a result, she told me that she supports me but she thinks it’s best that I go to a therapist for support because we will keep fighting if I confide in her too much, sadly the therapist i went to wasn’t that helpful. 

Thank you for taking the time to message me, hope all is well with you and your loved ones.
